# AeroTechnologies Inc.

*W*e are a highly focused company, specializing in providing engineering support services for
computational aerothermochemical problems in high-speed flows.

*O*ur areas of specialization include:
* General Reentry Aerothermodynamics
* General Missile Aerodynamics
* General Supersonic/Hypersonic Flows
* Modeling of Chemically Reacting Flows
* Modeling of Surface-Ablation and Surface-Recession Effects
* Computational Fluid Dynamics
* Computational Aerothermochemistry

*W*e develop techniques and tools needed to support design and analysis studies in these areas. We
provide direct engineering support and consulting services to clients who require accurate modeling
of high-speed flows.

*W*e strictly interface with only recognized US entities based within the USA

##### CORPORATE ANNOUNCEMENT

I am pleased to share the following leadership changes within The Inland Group of Companies,
effective October 1, 2025.

Mike Svedruzic, currently Chief Operating Officer, will assume the role of Chief Executive Officer,
as I transition into the role of Chair of the Inland Group of Companies. Mike has been with the
organization since 1998 and brings a deep understanding of our business, shared values and long-term
vision. I will continue to provide strategic guidance and support to the leadership team.

Vice President Canadian Operations, Engineering and Maintenance, Jonathan Hunt, will move into the
role of Chief Operating Officer and our current VP of Finance, Andrew Alford, will become Chief
Financial Officer.

These changes build on the strong foundation we have built over the years and reflect our deep
commitment to long-term, innovative growth. With that in mind, and after careful consideration and
planning, we have made the decision to bring together Inland Technologies International Limited
(ITIL) and Integrated Deicing Services (IDS) into a more unified and stronger organization under one
name – Inland Deicing Services.

This change will only strengthen our ability to achieve our mutual goals joining two teams who share
the same values and commitment to excellence. As we work through the transition plan, we will keep
you informed every step of the way. Most importantly, you have our commitment that we will continue
to deliver the exceptional service you have come to expect from us.

Roger Langille
President & Chief Executive Officer
The Inland Group of Companies

# We Wait for Airplanes,
# Airplanes Don't Wait for Us

Our sole focus is the safe, efficient, and professional delivery of deicing and anti-icing services
to our carrier customers.

[[IDS Introduction Video]][14]

IDS is dedicated to providing superior quality and service through the use of cutting-edge
technology to minimize costs and maximize efficiency.

By utilizing our unique deicing management programs, forced-air-first approach, and
blend-to-temperature methods, we significantly reduce glycol consumption at the source.

[Stay on Schedule with IDS][15]

## Why IDS

Readiness is a crucial component of what we do: circumstances and weather can change rapidly.
Expertise, planning, communication, and flexibility are what makes IDS a leader in the aircraft
deicing industry.

##### [Snowmageddon][16]

St. John's International Airport (YYT), located in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, receives some
of the harshest winter weather in North America. It is among the top five windiest cities, as well
as the foggiest, snowiest, and iciest in Canada.

Read More...

##### [New Year's Eve Rescue][17]

At approximately 7:00 PM on New Year's Eve, at one of the largest airports in the U.S., our IDS
station received a call from a major airline asking for help. They had almost 70 employees out sick,
and they needed assistance to keep their aircraft moving.

Read More...

##### [Alaska Airlift][18]

COVID-19 has had a dramatic effect on businesses around the world. When the pandemic hit, global
supply chains were stricken with logistics issues.

Read More...

Our unique deicing optimization program integrates our five core values and provides real-time data

[ logo]

Keeping our customers, employees, aircraft, passengers, and equipment safe is our No. 1 priority.

[ CORPORATE ANNOUNCEMENT ][1]

##### CORPORATE ANNOUNCEMENT

I am pleased to share the following leadership changes within The Inland Group of Companies,
effective October 1, 2025.

Mike Svedruzic, currently Chief Operating Officer, will assume the role of Chief Executive Officer,
as I transition into the role of Chair of the Inland Group of Companies. Mike has been with the
organization since 1998 and brings a deep understanding of our business, shared values and long-term
vision. I will continue to provide strategic guidance and support to the leadership team.

Vice President Canadian Operations, Engineering and Maintenance, Jonathan Hunt, will move into the
role of Chief Operating Officer and our current VP of Finance, Andrew Alford, will become Chief
Financial Officer.

These changes build on the strong foundation we have built over the years and reflect our deep
commitment to long-term, innovative growth. With that in mind, and after careful consideration and
planning, we have made the decision to bring together Inland Technologies International Limited
(ITIL) and Integrated Deicing Services (IDS) into a more unified and stronger organization under one
name – Inland Deicing Services.

This change will only strengthen our ability to achieve our mutual goals joining two teams who share
the same values and commitment to excellence. As we work through the transition plan, we will keep
you informed every step of the way. Most importantly, you have our commitment that we will continue
to deliver the exceptional service you have come to expect from us.

Roger Langille
President & Chief Executive Officer
The Inland Group of Companies

## Better GSE. Period.

AERO Specialties provides complete aircraft and airport ground support equipment (GSE) solutions to
corporate, FBO, MRO, military, airline and general aviation customers worldwide. AERO manufactures
and distributes industrial-grade new, used and refurbished aircraft GSE. We offer excellent pricing
and short lead times on an entire range of high-quality GSE. We supply an unprecedented variety of
service capabilities that are unmatched in the industry, allowing us to customize complete GSE
packages.

Our extensive and diverse product lines set us apart, making AERO the preferred GSE supplier for
over 16,000 organizations globally. Combine this with our team of professional mechanics and
engineers, revered customer service and an online parts store, and you have the best aircraft GSE
supplier in the business.

[Learn More][186]

## GSE Manufacturer & Global Supplier

### TLD

We supply and stock a large assortment of TLD Aircraft Ground Support Equipment. TLD GSE is
available in new, used, or refurbished condition. We also supply rentals on TLD GSE. From tow
tractors to beltloaders, GPUs and more – we carry it all.

### Used Equipment

We stock a large selection of used, refurbished and zero-timed aircraft GSE. Our team of certified
mechanics ensures equipment repairs are performed in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
Equipment trade-ins are available.

### Parts & Supplies

If we don’t stock it, we’ll find it. Ball Lock Pins, N2 & O2 Boosters, Regulators, Tug Hitches, GPU
Cables, Adapters, Couplers, Connectors, Hoses, Deice Fluid, Engines, Pumps. The Parts & Supplies
Department is ready for your GSE Parts request.

## Better GSE. Period.

AERO Specialties provides complete aircraft and airport ground support equipment (GSE) solutions to
corporate, FBO, MRO, military, airline and general aviation customers worldwide. AERO manufactures
and distributes industrial-grade new, used and refurbished aircraft GSE. We offer excellent pricing
and short lead times on an entire range of high-quality GSE. We supply an unprecedented variety of
service capabilities that are unmatched in the industry, allowing us to customize complete GSE
packages.

Our extensive and diverse product lines set us apart, making AERO the preferred GSE supplier for
over 16,000 organizations globally. Combine this with our team of professional mechanics and
engineers, revered customer service and an online parts store, and you have the best aircraft GSE
supplier in the business.

[Learn More][186]

## GSE Manufacturer & Global Supplier

### TLD

We supply and stock a large assortment of TLD Aircraft Ground Support Equipment. TLD GSE is
available in new, used, or refurbished condition. We also supply rentals on TLD GSE. From tow
tractors to beltloaders, GPUs and more – we carry it all.

### Used Equipment

We stock a large selection of used, refurbished and zero-timed aircraft GSE. Our team of certified
mechanics ensures equipment repairs are performed in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
Equipment trade-ins are available.

### Parts & Supplies

If we don’t stock it, we’ll find it. Ball Lock Pins, N2 & O2 Boosters, Regulators, Tug Hitches, GPU
Cables, Adapters, Couplers, Connectors, Hoses, Deice Fluid, Engines, Pumps. The Parts & Supplies
Department is ready for your GSE Parts request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Aircraft Anti-Icing

What is anti-icing and why is it necessary for aircraft?

Anti-icing is the process of applying fluids to prevent the formation of ice on aircraft surfaces.
It is essential to ensure the safety of the aircraft by maintaining its aerodynamic properties
during ground operations and takeoff.

How is anti-icing different from de-icing?

De-icing removes existing ice, frost, and snow, while anti-icing prevents the formation of ice after
de-icing or during conditions conducive to icing.

How long does the anti-icing protection last?

The duration of anti-icing protection depends on the type of fluid used, weather conditions, and the
aircraft's activity. Typically, Type IV fluids can provide extended protection compared to Type II
and III fluids.

Are your anti-icing fluids environmentally friendly?

Yes, we offer glycol-based anti-icing fluids designed to be effective while minimizing environmental
impact.

What types of anti-icing fluid do you sell?

We sell Type IV anti-icing fluid which is commonly used because of its long-lasting anti-icing
properties.

Can anti-icing fluids damage my aircraft's paint or components?

No, our anti-icing fluids are formulated to be safe for aircraft surfaces and components. We follow
recommended application procedures to ensure there is no damage.

### Aircraft De-icing

What is de-icing and why is it necessary for small airplanes?

De-icing is the process of removing ice, frost, and snow from the surfaces of an aircraft. It is
essential to ensure safe flight operations by maintaining the aircraft's aerodynamic properties and
preventing ice-related malfunctions.

Can de-icing fluids damage my aircraft's paint or components?

No, our de-icing fluids are specifically formulated to be safe for aircraft surfaces and components.

How long does the de-icing process take for a small airplane?

The duration of the de-icing process can vary depending on the extent of ice accumulation and the
size of the aircraft, but it typically takes between 15 to 30 minutes.

Are your de-icing fluids environmentally friendly?

Yes, we offer glycol-based de-icing fluids that are designed to be effective and have minimal
environmental impact.

How often should my small airplane be de-iced during winter operations?

The frequency of de-icing depends on weather conditions, but it is essential to perform de-icing
before every flight if there is ice, frost, or snow accumulation.

### De-icing and Anti-icing Fluids

What is the difference between de-icing fluid and anti-icing fluid?
* **Functionality:** De-icing fluids remove ice, while anti-icing fluids prevent new ice formation.
* **Duration:** De-icing fluids have a shorter effective period, whereas anti-icing fluids provide
  prolonged protection.
* **Application Timing:** De-icing fluids are applied to remove ice, while anti-icing fluids are
  applied afterward to maintain ice-free surfaces.
What is the mixture for the Type I RTU (Ready-to-Use) De-icing fluid?

The Type I fluid is prepared by combining 55% Type I fluid with 45% Water.

Is the de-icing and anti-icing fluids Biodegradable?

Yes, they are fully biodegradable.

How long is the fluid good for?

If stored properly, the shelf life of both the de-icing and anti-icing fluids is two years from
manufacture date.

### Handheld Sprayers

How hot will the fluid be heated to?

The heater will heat the fluid to a max of 120 degrees.

Are the sprayers available in smaller sizes than the 3 gallon unit?

No, we only carry the 3 gallon units.

What is the hose length?

42 inches.

How far will the spray go?

The spray stream will reach up to 24 feet.

### Operational Considerations

How often should my aircraft be treated with anti-icing fluids during winter operations?

The frequency depends on weather conditions and the duration of ground operations. It is essential
to reapply anti-icing fluids if the aircraft is exposed to freezing conditions for extended periods
before takeoff.

What should I do if I suspect the anti-icing fluid is no longer effective?

Contact us immediately for a reapplication of anti-icing fluids. It is crucial to ensure the
aircraft remains protected from ice formation.

No, we only carry the 3 gallon units.

What is the hose length?

42 inches.

How far will the spray go?

The spray stream will reach up to 24 feet.

### Operational Considerations

How often should my aircraft be treated with anti-icing fluids during winter operations?

The frequency depends on weather conditions and the duration of ground operations. It is essential
to reapply anti-icing fluids if the aircraft is exposed to freezing conditions for extended periods
before takeoff.

What should I do if I suspect the anti-icing fluid is no longer effective?

Contact us immediately for a reapplication of anti-icing fluids. It is crucial to ensure the
aircraft remains protected from ice formation.

## Stop Losing Money on Flights You Already Flew

Flight schools typically lose 10-20% of revenue on flights that were flown but never properly
billed. Aviatize closes that gap — every Hobbs tick becomes an invoice line, automatically.

Flight time becomes an itemized invoice the moment the aircraft is checked in — nothing to remember,
nothing to retype.

Wet, dry, instructor, and package rates calculate per booking. No spreadsheet math, no manual
corrections.

### Paid before they leave

Students settle invoices from the app on the spot — not weeks later, or never.

### Reminders chase, not your staff

Automated follow-up on unpaid invoices, so collection stops depending on someone's to-do list.

## Stop Losing Money on Flights You Already Flew

Flight schools typically lose 10-20% of revenue on flights that were flown but never properly
billed. Aviatize closes that gap — every Hobbs tick becomes an invoice line, automatically.

### Hobbs to invoice, automatically

Flight time becomes an itemized invoice the moment the aircraft is checked in — nothing to remember,
nothing to retype.

### Rates apply themselves

Wet, dry, instructor, and package rates calculate per booking. No spreadsheet math, no manual
corrections.

### Paid before they leave

Students settle invoices from the app on the spot — not weeks later, or never.

### Reminders chase, not your staff

Automated follow-up on unpaid invoices, so collection stops depending on someone's to-do list.

Find quick answers to common questions about our services and offerings.

### In what formats can I download the ordered reports?

Reports are available in Microsoft Word, PDF, and PowerPoint formats for user convenience.

### How do I get the receipt of my purchases?

A detailed invoice is automatically sent to your registered email after successful payment

### What do single user, multi-user and enterprise license mean?
* **Single User License:** Access for one individual.
* **Multi-User License:** Access for a few users within the same organization.
* **Enterprise License:** Unlimited access across the entire organization.

Yes, sample reports are available on request to help you assess the report’s quality and structure.

2025年1月1日付けで、当社を消滅会社、理研アルマイト工業株式会社（代表取締役：上野翼）を存続会社とする

時に行う予定であり、これにより、当社完全持株会社であるRCホールディングス株式会社の傘下において、表面

とともに高い品質管理を求められる化学業界において、私たちはお客様より指定の検査や日本工業規格（JIS）

One Air is a **flight training centre in Spain **approved by the Spanish Aviation Safety and
Security Agency (AESA) and certified by the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) as Approved
Training Organisation E-ATO 190.

**Our flight school has its main base of operations next to Malaga International Airport,** which,
given its location in the south of Spain, offers **the best weather conditions in Europe for the
training of pilots.**

Founded in 2010 by commercial pilots and instructors, One Air is an aviation school created by
pilots, for pilots. Our philosophy essentially boils down to equipping our students with **the
latest top-end technologies in the aviation sector and offering the highest standards of safety**.

In 2024, we take a step forward to set ourselves apart from other ab-initio pilot schools, with the
creation of the [new BOEING 737 MAX Simulator Lab][72], with **more than 300 m² of modern facilities
dedicated exclusively** to one of the most advanced new generation commercial aircraft in the world.

This has led us to be **awarded three times**, by Avion Revue International, as **[Best Flight
School in Spain][73], in 2020, 2021 and 2024**.

¹*Artistry* — a dedication to the details that shape flight in its smoothest form.

Our Services

## *Seamless *is just the surface

From your time in the air, to those moments in between, over 4,500 aviation experts are dedicated to

Kilfrost Europe - specialists in

# Aircraft De-icing & Anti-icing Products

[Find Out More ][23]

Europe’s Leading ADF Producer

## Market-leading Products

Since the 1930s Kilfrost has developed and produced Aircraft De-icing fluids that make aviation
safer. The Kilfrost brand has grown steadily reflecting the growth in aviation and it is today one
of the leading producers within the industry.

[Card image cap]

##### Type I DF Plus

###### DE-ICING FLUID

Water/glycol fluid with at least 80% of glycol and corrosion inhibition to remove safely all winter
contamination conforming to AMS 1424, ISO 11075

[Learn more ][24]
[Card image cap]

##### Type II ABC-K Plus

###### DE/ANTI-ICING FLUID

Fluid with at least 50% glycol that protects the aircraft against re-freezing (Anti-icing) and can
also be used in “single fluid” de/anti-icing operation conforming to AMS 1428, ISO 11078

[Learn more ][25]
[Card image cap]

##### Type IV ABC-S Plus

###### DE/ANTI-ICING FLUID

Fluid with the best holdover time and at least 50% glycol that protects the aircraft against
re-freezing (Anti-icing) and can also be used in “single fluid” de/anti-icing operation conforming
to AMS 1428, ISO 11078

[Learn more ][26]

## Outstanding Service & Support

[Card image cap]

##### Customer Support

###### DEDICATED TEAM

We answer all your technical enquiries and are available 24/7 for your logistical needs.

[Learn more ][27]
[Card image cap]

##### On-site Training

###### WE SHARE OUR KNOWLEDGE

Kilfrost Europe organises on-site training at our production site in Antwerp or at our customers’
place of operation.

[Learn more ][28]
[Card image cap]

##### Distribution

###### RAPID RESPONSE & DELIVERY

Experienced logistic operation with strategic safety stocks all over Europe to minimize the delivery
time.

[Learn more ][29]
[Card image cap]

##### Live Monitoring

###### CAREFREE WINTERS

On request, we can install on-site telemetric equipment to monitor fluid levels to avoid operational
interruptions.

[Learn more ][30]

## Europe-wide Distribution Network

Antwerp is the biggest chemical hub in Europe with vast logistic connections to all European
countries via road, train, and ship.

[Learn more ][31]
[Weather Forecast Maps[Temperature, 2 m above ground, 47°N 10°E, 2020/12/10 12:00 (UTC), ©
VentuSky.com]][32]

## Check the Forecast

To anticipate winter activity and ensure reliable supplies, we check the weather forecast daily.
Here you can check the current weather and predictions at your location.

[Learn more ][33]

MeteoFocus delivers **highly accurate, localized weather forecasts and data** in a clear,
user-friendly view, accessible anytime from anywhere via your web browser or our mobile iOS and
Android apps

The MeteoFocus portal is tailored specifically to the needs of **winter and summer services** for
**cities, municipalities** and **airports**, as well as **local and long-distance transport**. Our
technology leverages the [METIS system][34], which combines diverse data sources, artificial
intelligence (AI) and cutting-edge measurement technology with extensive meteorological expertise.

Our **local teams of qualified meteorologists** personally monitor the weather in your operational
area and provides daily, tailored forecasts to meet your specific needs. During extreme weather
conditions, you’ll receive a personalized written alert and benefit from 24/7 access to our
meteorological support for any questions.

## Our Weather Forecast Services

### Accurate Local Forecasts

Our forecasts are extremely precise, and our high-resolution model captures subtle differences with
exceptional accuracy

### Custom Dashboard

Our portal offers a personalized view that adapts to your needs while being intuitive and easy to
navigate

### Proprietary Data Integration

Seamlessly integrate your own measurement data into MeteoFocus for even more precise custom weather
forecasts

### Specialized Parameter Development

Benefit from specialized parameters such as Green Space Index, Leaf Fall Index, Grit Index, and
Industrial Snow Index

### Specialized in Surface Models

Our forecasts cover all critical surfaces—from roads and bike paths to bridges, railways, aircraft
wings, and runways

### 24/7 Meteorological Support

Our team of qualified meteorologists is available 24/7 to assist you with any weather-related
questions

news, and more.

company status.

# provıron

## chemistry between us

[ [NY Campaign banner Proviron] ][50]

**we are proviron, a chemical company manufacturing innovative ‘in-between’ products. **

**we are the chain between the raw material suppliers and the processing industry****.**

and we do it our sustainable way, ingrained into our DNA since 1977.

[ proviflow | heating & cooling ][51]
[ proviplast | plasticizers ][52]
[ provifrost | aviation de-icing ][53]
[ provichem | fine chemicals ][54]
[ animal health | feed additives ][55]
[ tolling | contract manufacturing ][56]

chemistry is all around

The products we use daily are more complex to meet today’s living standards. The biggest challenge
for the future is to rethink the way we deal with the life cycle of products. And that’s exactly
what Proviron is doing by focusing on Processes and Environment.

We are servicing the manufacturing business with a wide variety of services, solutions and products.

People, Planet, Prosperity are the core values of our company and our pillars towards a
cradle-to-cradle economy, where used products become materials of the future.

We believe that well considered product and manufacturing choices today will leverage the journey to
reusable resources for tomorrow.

[ innovative in
PROCESSES ][57]

At Proviron we make intermediate products for various niche markets. We approach each industry with
dedication and respect for uniqueness of the sector. Through a personalized approach, thorough
research and mastery of production processes, we can offer innovative solutions.

[ respect for
ENVIRONMENT ][58]

Chemistry and the environment may seem incompatible, but we believe that taking care of the
environment on all possible levels helps us as an industry grow towards a more sustainable and
livable world. Not only initiatives on the shop floor, but also marco-economic changes will
determine the future of the industry. Today we are contributing our part to the chemistry of
tomorrow.

# provıron

## chemistry between us

[ [NY Campaign banner Proviron] ][50]

**we are proviron, a chemical company manufacturing innovative ‘in-between’ products. **

**we are the chain between the raw material suppliers and the processing industry****.**

and we do it our sustainable way, ingrained into our DNA since 1977.

[ proviflow | heating & cooling ][51]
[ proviplast | plasticizers ][52]
[ provifrost | aviation de-icing ][53]
[ provichem | fine chemicals ][54]
[ animal health | feed additives ][55]
[ tolling | contract manufacturing ][56]

chemistry is all around

The products we use daily are more complex to meet today’s living standards. The biggest challenge
for the future is to rethink the way we deal with the life cycle of products. And that’s exactly
what Proviron is doing by focusing on Processes and Environment.

We are servicing the manufacturing business with a wide variety of services, solutions and products.

People, Planet, Prosperity are the core values of our company and our pillars towards a
cradle-to-cradle economy, where used products become materials of the future.

We believe that well considered product and manufacturing choices today will leverage the journey to
reusable resources for tomorrow.

[ innovative in
PROCESSES ][57]

At Proviron we make intermediate products for various niche markets. We approach each industry with
dedication and respect for uniqueness of the sector. Through a personalized approach, thorough
research and mastery of production processes, we can offer innovative solutions.

[ respect for
ENVIRONMENT ][58]

Chemistry and the environment may seem incompatible, but we believe that taking care of the
environment on all possible levels helps us as an industry grow towards a more sustainable and
livable world. Not only initiatives on the shop floor, but also marco-economic changes will
determine the future of the industry. Today we are contributing our part to the chemistry of
tomorrow.

# SkyGeek — Supplying the Skies Since 1983

SkyGeek has been serving the aviation community for over 40 years, providing the parts, tools, and
materials that keep aircraft airborne. With deep inventory, fast shipping, and remarkable service,
we make it easy to get what you need — when you need it.

## Shop Our Categories

## Why Choose SkyGeek?
* Extensive Selection - Shop aircraft parts, pilot supplies, aviation consumables, and aerospace
  products all in one place.
* Fast & Reliable - Count on quick shipping and dependable delivery to keep you flying.
* Trusted Experience - Backed by 40+ years in aviation supply and proudly part of the GracoRoberts
  family.
* Personal Service - Big enough to Supply the Skies, small enough to provide real, human support.
* For Every Aviator - Serving pilots, mechanics, flight schools, corporate aviation, and government

## Tailored Fiber Placement
## Für Ihre robusten und langlebigen Produkte

Sie stellen hohe Anforderungen an die Leistungsfähigkeit und Langlebigkeit Ihrer **Produkte aus
Kunststoff** – Thermoplaste (Polypropylen (PP), PEEK, Polyamid 6 (PA6)) und Duroplaste
(Polyesterharze, Epoxidharze, Silikone) – **SMC-Material** (Gemisch aus Reaktionsharzen und
Glasfasern) oder **Beton**.

Herkömmliche Fertigungsmethoden stoßen bei der **Komplexität Ihrer Bauteile** an ihre Grenzen?
Tailored Fiber Placement schafft komplexe Formen und Strukturen ohne aufwändige Bearbeitungsschritte
oder Montageprozesse.

Ihre Anwendungen bedingen **spezielle mechanische oder strukturelle Eigenschaften**, die schwer mit
konventionellen Fertigungsmethoden zu erreichen sind? Mit [Tailored Fiber Placement][89] platzieren
wir für Sie eine bestimmte Kombination von Fasern genau so, dass die Bauteile Ihre Anforderungen
erfüllen.

Sie entwickeln oder optimieren **Materialien für Hochleistungsanwendungen**, die extrem leicht und
gleichzeitig extrem steif und zugfest sein müssen? Mit Tailored Fiber Placement maximieren wir die
Festigkeit Ihrer Bauteile bei minimalem Gewicht.

**Tailored Fiber Placement eröffnet Ihnen vollkommen neue Möglichkeiten für Ihre Produkte!**

## Gezielte Verstärkung durch Tailored Fiber Placement

Tailored Fiber Placement (TFP) ist ein Verfahren zur Fertigung textiler Halbzeuge aus Fasersträngen.
Unsere CNC-Stickmaschinen verlegen Faserstränge (auch Rovings genannt) aus Carbon, Glasfaser, Aramid
und anderen Fasern auf flexible Trägermaterialien. Die Faserorientierung richten wir individuell auf
die Kraftverläufe in Ihrem Produkt aus. Zwischen den Stichen bewegen die Stickmaschinen das
Trägermaterial und sticken die Fasern in der optimalen Faserausrichtung auf. Problemlos integrieren
wir bei der Faserverlegung auch Funktionsfäden, Sensoren, sowie Drähte oder Heizleiter in jeder
beliebigen Form in Ihre Faser-Preforms. Alternativ wird dieses Verfahren auch Roving-Legen genannt.

[**Mehr über Tailored Fiber Placement erfahren**][91]

## Profitieren Sie von Tailored Fiber Placement

#### Wirtschaftlich

Kosteneffiziente Herstellung komplexer Preforms, textiler Sensoren und Heizelemente

#### Komplexe Strukturen

Herstellung komplexer Muster, Schichten oder Anordnungen von Fasern zur punktgenauen Verstärkung

#### Leicht & stabil

Leichte Fasern und Trägermaterialien, aber hohe Steifigkeit durch optimale Ausrichtung

#### Hybrid

Individuelle Kombination von Leichtbaufasern (Carbon, Glasfaser, Aramid, Basalt, …) und Metallen

#### Multifunktional

Nahtlose Integration von Heizdrähten oder Sensorfäden in Faserstrukturen

#### Reproduzierbar

Herstellung mit hoher Wiederholgenauigkeit in Klein- und Großserien

## Verstärkung aus Naturfasern für Ihre nachhaltigen Produkte

Wenn Sie besonderen Wert auf die Nachhaltigkeit Ihrer Produkte legen, nutzen Sie Naturfasern statt
Carbon oder Glasfaser. Pflanzliche Fasern wie Flachs, Hanf oder Jute eignen sich auch als Rovings
für Tailored Fiber Placement. Als erneuerbare Ressourcen punkten sie im Vergleich zu herkömmlichen
Fasern mit ihrer Umweltfreundlichkeit. Sie sind **biologisch abbaubar**, **sehr leicht** und
**biokompatibel**. Auch Naturfasern bieten Ihnen komplette Designfreiheit.

Nachhaltigkeit ist ein wichtiger Wert in unserem Unternehmen.

* Sie suchen einen Hersteller, der gemeinsam mit Ihnen eine **individuelle Faserverstärkung
  entwickelt**, die Ihr Bauteil genau dort **flexibel verstärkt**, wo Sie die strukturelle
  Leistungsfähigkeit am meisten benötigen?



Das ist unser Fachgebiet – von der Idee bis zur Serienfertigung.

[**Mehr erfahren**][82]
[[Elektrische Heizelemente vom Hersteller TFP Technology]][83]

## [Elektrische Heizelemente - auch zur Integration in Faserverbundwerk&shystoffe & andere
## Kunststoffe][84]
* Sie benötigen eine **Heizfunktion**, um sie **nahtlos** und **materialhomogen **in Ihr
  Faserverbundbauteil oder Kunststoff-Produkt zu **integrieren**?
* Ihr Heizelement muss **besonders flexibel** und **widerstandsfähig **sein?
* Sie suchen einen Hersteller, der Layout, Größe und Heizleistung genau für Ihre Anforderungen
  umsetzen kann?



Damit kennen wir uns bestens aus – von der Idee bis zur Serienfertigung.

[**Mehr erfahren**][85]

[[Sensormatten & textile Sensoren vom Hersteller TFP Technology]][86]

## [Textile Sensoren
## für Preforms und andere Anwendungen][87]
* Sie wollen Ihr Faserverbundbauteil um **notwendige oder zusätzliche Funktionen** erweitern?
* Sie suchen einen Hersteller, der Funktionsfäden zum Damage-Sensing, zur Messdaten-Erfassung,
  Datenübertragung und vieles mehr nahtlos als Sensormatte oder Faser-Preform in Ihr Bauteil
  integriert?

 

Darin sind wir spezialisiert – von der Idee bis zur Serienfertigung.

[**Mehr erfahren**][88]

## Tailored Fiber Placement
## Für Ihre robusten und langlebigen Produkte

Sie stellen hohe Anforderungen an die Leistungsfähigkeit und Langlebigkeit Ihrer **Produkte aus
Kunststoff** – Thermoplaste (Polypropylen (PP), PEEK, Polyamid 6 (PA6)) und Duroplaste
(Polyesterharze, Epoxidharze, Silikone) – **SMC-Material** (Gemisch aus Reaktionsharzen und
Glasfasern) oder **Beton**.

Herkömmliche Fertigungsmethoden stoßen bei der **Komplexität Ihrer Bauteile** an ihre Grenzen?
Tailored Fiber Placement schafft komplexe Formen und Strukturen ohne aufwändige Bearbeitungsschritte
oder Montageprozesse.

Ihre Anwendungen bedingen **spezielle mechanische oder strukturelle Eigenschaften**, die schwer mit
konventionellen Fertigungsmethoden zu erreichen sind? Mit [Tailored Fiber Placement][89] platzieren
wir für Sie eine bestimmte Kombination von Fasern genau so, dass die Bauteile Ihre Anforderungen
erfüllen.

Sie entwickeln oder optimieren **Materialien für Hochleistungsanwendungen**, die extrem leicht und
gleichzeitig extrem steif und zugfest sein müssen? Mit Tailored Fiber Placement maximieren wir die
Festigkeit Ihrer Bauteile bei minimalem Gewicht.

**Tailored Fiber Placement eröffnet Ihnen vollkommen neue Möglichkeiten für Ihre Produkte!**

[ Vereinbaren Sie jetzt einen Termin ][90]

## Gezielte Verstärkung durch Tailored Fiber Placement

Tailored Fiber Placement (TFP) ist ein Verfahren zur Fertigung textiler Halbzeuge aus Fasersträngen.
Unsere CNC-Stickmaschinen verlegen Faserstränge (auch Rovings genannt) aus Carbon, Glasfaser, Aramid
und anderen Fasern auf flexible Trägermaterialien. Die Faserorientierung richten wir individuell auf
die Kraftverläufe in Ihrem Produkt aus. Zwischen den Stichen bewegen die Stickmaschinen das
Trägermaterial und sticken die Fasern in der optimalen Faserausrichtung auf. Problemlos integrieren
wir bei der Faserverlegung auch Funktionsfäden, Sensoren, sowie Drähte oder Heizleiter in jeder
beliebigen Form in Ihre Faser-Preforms. Alternativ wird dieses Verfahren auch Roving-Legen genannt.

[**Mehr über Tailored Fiber Placement erfahren**][91]

## Profitieren Sie von Tailored Fiber Placement

#### Wirtschaftlich

Kosteneffiziente Herstellung komplexer Preforms, textiler Sensoren und Heizelemente

#### Komplexe Strukturen

Herstellung komplexer Muster, Schichten oder Anordnungen von Fasern zur punktgenauen Verstärkung

#### Leicht & stabil

Leichte Fasern und Trägermaterialien, aber hohe Steifigkeit durch optimale Ausrichtung

#### Hybrid

Individuelle Kombination von Leichtbaufasern (Carbon, Glasfaser, Aramid, Basalt, …) und Metallen

#### Multifunktional

Nahtlose Integration von Heizdrähten oder Sensorfäden in Faserstrukturen

#### Reproduzierbar

Herstellung mit hoher Wiederholgenauigkeit in Klein- und Großserien

## Verstärkung aus Naturfasern für Ihre nachhaltigen Produkte

Wenn Sie besonderen Wert auf die Nachhaltigkeit Ihrer Produkte legen, nutzen Sie Naturfasern statt
Carbon oder Glasfaser. Pflanzliche Fasern wie Flachs, Hanf oder Jute eignen sich auch als Rovings
für Tailored Fiber Placement. Als erneuerbare Ressourcen punkten sie im Vergleich zu herkömmlichen
Fasern mit ihrer Umweltfreundlichkeit. Sie sind **biologisch abbaubar**, **sehr leicht** und
**biokompatibel**. Auch Naturfasern bieten Ihnen komplette Designfreiheit.

Nachhaltigkeit ist ein wichtiger Wert in unserem Unternehmen.

[** Erfahren Sie mehr darüber**][92]

## "Made in Germany" von TFP Technology

TFP Technology ist Ihr Hersteller für textile Preforms, elektrische Heizelemente und Sensormatten
mit Sitz im vogtländischen Falkenstein. Das sächsische Vogtland ist schon immer ein wichtiges
Zentrum der deutschen Textilindustrie. Vor Ort finden wir ausgebildetes Fachpersonal für unsere
technische Stickerei, die Basis für das Tailored Fiber Placement. Mit erfahrenen und motivierten
Mitarbeitern aus der Region entwickeln und produzieren wir höchste Qualität „Made in Germany“. 

Gemeinsam mit Ihnen erarbeiten wir individuelle Preforms, Heizelemente und Sensormatten passgenau

ersten Anfrage oder Idee über die Entwicklung der Layouts und Umsetzung der Prototypen bis hin zur
Serienfertigung kompetent zur Seite.
Wir garantieren Ihnen Flexibilität und kürzeste Reaktionszeiten. Ihre Zufriedenheit ist unser
höchster Anspruch!

Wir verstehen uns als Problemlöser.

## The Brinery

## what is liquid deicing solution?

Liquid deicing is a modern alternative to using traditional rock salt or sand for managing snow and
ice. Unlike those methods, liquids start working right away, helping to make surfaces safe faster.
Liquids are the future of snow and ice control, and in the next 10 years, spreading loads of rock
salt will likely be a thing of the past.

[Large-1.jpg]

## What are the benefits?

Using liquids comes with a lot of benefits, like saving money on salt, applying more evenly and
accurately, being easier to adapt to different conditions, and being better for the environment. In
the long run, it is the safer, more effective option.

 

In fact, many places in the U.S. are already setting limits on chloride use or switching to
chloride-free options. It’s only a matter of time before these changes reach your area, so it’s
smart to stay ahead of the curve!

## We provide custom liquid de-icing solutions tailored to meet your needs. Here’s what we offer:

### Convenience

Get the exact amount of de-icing solution you need, from small batches to large volumes, customized
to suit your requirements.

### Flexibility

Our flexible services are tailored to your needs, ensuring you're prepared without wasting time or
resources. Stay ahead of winter with solutions built to meet your demand.

### On-Demand Service

Access liquid de-icing solutions anytime with our on-demand service, offering convenient delivery or
collection options to suit your needs. 

## OUR SERVICES

Our liquid de-icers and brine are available for pick up or delivery. Deliveries are made by totes or
by dispensing liquids into your container. 

[Untitled.png]

 BRINE TOTES 

250 gallon totes of brine ready for pick up or delivery available at your convenience.

blended brine

90% Brine, 10% additive of Winter Sentry blended by us, ready for pick up or delivery available

[Brine tote for brine and additives for liquid de-icing solutions]

custom blend

We provide the option to create a custom brine blend specifically tailored to your de-icing needs.

[Call Now ][5]

# Did you know...

Did you know that salt can take up to 45 minutes to go to work on making your surfaces safe?

 

That’s because it takes moisture to turn that salt into a brine. Only then does granular salt start
working. 

 

Skip a step and create a safe surface for your customers immediately upon application. 

[Reach out and we’ll show you how! ][6]

The Brinery is your trusted de-icing solution supplier for Massachusetts. It was created to fill the

de-icing solutions are not only effective but also in line with the latest industry standards.

## About Tianyi

**Jiangsu Tianyi Aviation Industry Co., Ltd.**
Jiangsu Tianyi Aviation Industry Co., Ltd. was established in 2011. It is a high-tech enterprise
specializing in high-end specialized equipment for civil aviation airports and overall smart airport
solutions. It is also a national key "small giant" enterprise with specialization, innovation,
specialization, and unique competitiveness. In 2025, the company was awarded the Jiangsu Province
Intellectual Property Strategy Promotion Plan Project and the Jiangsu Province Advanced Intelligent
Factory. Its products cover civil aviation green equipment (civil aviation fuel, new energy series
airport-specific equipment/vehicles), safe airport equipment (civil aviation and airport-specific
equipment/vehicles automatic safety docking system ASD), civil aviation new energy vehicle
networking and big data security supervision and operation system, and smart airport overall
solutions (civil aviation 5G system construction, L4-level autonomous driving technology research
and manufacturing, 5G autonomous driving test field technical services, vehicle-road collaboration
overall solution) etc

**Jiangsu Tianyi Aviation Industry Co., Ltd.**
Jiangsu Tianyi Aviation Industry Co., Ltd. was established in 2011. It is a high-tech enterprise
specializing in high-end specialized equipment for civil aviation airports and overall smart airport
solutions. It is also a national key "small giant" enterprise with specialization, innovation,
specialization, and unique competitiveness. In 2025, the company was awarded the Jiangsu Province
Intellectual Property Strategy Promotion Plan Project and the Jiangsu Province Advanced Intelligent
Factory. Its products cover civil aviation green equipment (civil aviation fuel, new energy series
airport-specific equipment/vehicles), safe airport equipment (civil aviation and airport-specific
equipment/vehicles automatic safety docking system ASD), civil aviation new energy vehicle
networking and big data security supervision and operation system, and smart airport overall
solutions (civil aviation 5G system construction, L4-level autonomous driving technology research
and manufacturing, 5G autonomous driving test field technical services, vehicle-road collaboration
overall solution) etc
